description: This file provides support for interacting with DataRobot's API endpoint for chat completions, extending functionality for API URL resolution, API key management, and configuration setup tailored for DataRobot's OpenAI-compatible interface.

classes.name: DataRobotConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for DataRobot's chat API, extending a base OpenAILikeChatConfig to handle API URL and key resolution specific to DataRobot.

methods.name: str _resolve_api_key(api_key: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Resolves the API key, prioritizing provided key, then secret manager, and defaults to a fake key for testing if unavailable.

methods.name: Optional[str] _resolve_api_base(api_base: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL, adding specific paths based on existing URL structure or defaulting to DataRobot's standard URL.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Ensures both API base and key are set, falling back on secret manager values if needed.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs and returns the complete API URL for chat completion requests.

ctags.name: get_complete_url
ctags.signature: ( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
